title: Very well designed and flow but have 1 hiccups

I really loved how it very easy to uses and have kind of sorted as we expected how a to do list would become. However only 1 thing that really annoyed me is, when you tried to scroll using finger on your left hand, some how the check box is selected  and the task mark as finished. Another suggestions, added an Undo popups might helped, or have logic to detect scrolling and/hold so that option should not ticked.

title: The best of personal task management which only need Apple Watch support to make it perfect.
body:
Syncing across platform? Check
Easy to use with tons of features? Check
Simple UI yet so powerful? Check
Child task inside a task? Check
Strong integration with Windows and web app? Check
Apple Watch app available? Nay….

In fact it is much better than iPhone’s Reminders app makes me make this app my first choice as my daily driver.
If only this app support Apple Watch and have its own app, I will definitely not use Reminders and just go for this app all way long.

Please make Apple Watch version app so I can fully free from Apple’s Reminders. I know your powerful dev can make it happens.

Pretty please……
